item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 13/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine weather to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China on Friday and Saturday. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, it will be warm and misty over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will fall over the region.
